scripts.pdf:lin: for f in supports/*.md;       do md-to-pdf --launch-options '{"args": ["--no-sandbox"]}' --document-title "$(basename "${f}" .md)" --config-file ./.vitepress/pdf-config.js "${f}" ; done && cp supports/*.pdf .vitepress/dist/supports/
scripts.pdf:win: for /r %F in (supports\*.md) do md-to-pdf                                                   --document-title "%~nF"                     --config-file .\.vitepress\pdf-config.js "%F"        && cp supports/*.pdf .vitepress/dist/supports/
scripts.slidev:lin: BASE=$(node -p "require('./package.json').siteBase") && for f in slides/*.md; do slidev build "${f}" --out "../.vitepress/dist/slides/$(basename "${f}" .md)" --base "${BASE}slides/$(basename "${f}" .md)/" ; done
scripts.slidev:win: for /f "delims=" %B in ('node -p "require('./package.json').siteBase"') do @for %%F in (slides\*.md) do slidev build "%%F" --out "..\.vitepress\dist\slides\%%~nF" --base "%Bslides/%%~nF/"
